prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for most specific change types because only choose_path copy and home wait_info have at least two tests.
Copy changes in choose_path (choose_path, copy) consistently made performance worse across multiple tests.
Waiting step info (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Redesigning friend selection (adoption, redesign) and reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) were helpful, winning their tests.
Layout changes, notification toggles, and new visual tip screens had no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected measured outcomes.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, layout: -0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +6.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, copy: -4.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, layout: -1.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -2.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, notification: +2.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +0.6% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 69.8%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.3%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, redesign] Split layout sign-in screen redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen into a split layout to clearly separate authentication options from pet progress context. (why: Sign-in step has 76.0% conversion, and 2 support emails reported app stalling or sign-in screens failing to load properly.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet naming screen before account setup: Add a new screen after adoption certificate where users enter and confirm their pet's name before proceeding to sign-in. (why: Adoption step drops 30.2% of users with an 89s median time; introducing a quick naming step boosts ownership before account creation.)
2: [adoption, hint] Photo quality guideline hint on photo upload screen: Add an explicit hint and quality badge to the photo upload screen explaining best photo lighting and angles. (why: 3 support emails mentioned custom pet creation failing or looking wrong after photo upload.)
3: [home, new_flow] Interactive wait screen animation replace: Replace the standard wait status with a custom progress and live companion preview component. (why: Waiting step takes a median of 201s (mean 2336s) with an 18.7% dropoff rate before entering home.)
4: [finish, hint] Desktop control hint on finish screen: Add a hint to the final home intro screen explaining basic mouse controls and right-click actions for the pet. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding, and finish step drops 35.2% of remaining users.)
5: [choose_path, redesign] Story scroll layout for story screen: Redesign the onboarding story screen to a story_scroll layout to improve narrative engagement. (why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users, and layout redesigns have proven more effective than pure copy edits in earlier tests.)
6: [finish, new_screen] Desktop companion placement guide screen: Insert a new screen before home intro showing users where the pet sits on screen and how desktop launch works. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing up on desktop or app not opening, while 4 emails reported desktop feature misbehavior.)
7: [home, notification] Sound notification toggle on waiting screen: Add a sound notification trigger component to the waiting screen so users get an audio cue when setup finishes. (why: Waiting screen mean duration is 2336s (median 201s), causing users to switch away and forget the desktop app.)
8: [adoption, redesign] Split layout redesign for adoption certificate: Redesign adoption certificate to a split layout featuring pet preview on one side and official details on the other. (why: Adoption step drops 30.2% of users with an average time of 1017s; visual redesigns in adoption previously improved conversion.)
